newsitem.title: USA: Kansas City Power names three executive VPs.
newsitem.headline: Kansas City Power names three executive VPs.

text.p: Kansas City Power & Light Co said it has named three new executive vice presidents as part of its strategic reorganization.

In a release dated October 11, the company said Bernard Beaudoin was named executive vice president and chief financial officer, with responsibility for the company's corporate finance and administration. He previously served as president of the subsidiary KLT Inc.

Marcus Jackson becomes executive vice president and chief operating officer, with responsibility for consolidating KCPL's utility operations, the company said. Jackson was formerly senior vice president of power supply.
KCPL said it also named Turner White executive vice president of corporate development. White was previously senior vice president for retail services.
